text.description_html:
Don-Jo 4-CW, Wrap Around 9" x 4-1/4" Door Plate for 1-3/4" Thick Doors with 2-3/4" Backsets

The 4-CW Wrap Around 9" x 4-1/4" Door Plate is for 1-3/4" thick doors with a 2-3/4" backset and a 2-1/8" bore-hole. Plates like this one are most often used to cover an existing bore-hole to change the backset, hole dimension, or knob placement. They can also be used to increase security at your home or office by protecting your doors from entry tools and tampering.

Also Available:
2-CW Wrap Around Plate for 1-3/4 Inch Door with 2-3/8 Inch Backset
1-CW Wrap Around Plate for 1-3/8 Inch Door with 2-3/8 Inch Backset
3-CW Wrap Around Plate for 1-3/8 Inch Door with 2-3/4 Inch Backset

Features of the Don-Jo 4 CW Wrap Around 9-inch Door Security Plate:

  • Built-in stainless steel threaded insert for tube latch.
  • Long lasting and secure mounting of latch and bolt.
  • Heavy duty stainless steel trim screws
  • Permanent holding power eliminates loosening of latch mounting screws

Specifications of the Wrap Around 9" x 4-1/4" Plate for Cylindrical Door Locks with 2-1/8" Hole:

  • Plate Length: 9"
  • Plate Width: 4-1/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Material: 22 (.032 gauge) construction
  • Don-Jo 4-CW Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

When Selecting a Finish: The Base Material is Determined by the Finish

  • Brushed Stainless Steel Finish -- Stainless Steel Base Material
  • Polished Brass Finish -- Brass Base Material
  • Oil Rubbed Bronze Finish -- Bronze Base Material
  • Antique Brass Finish -- Brass Base Material
